question: Can an evolved population rule improve the chapter reconstructed 5+1 MPSO when 200 peaks compete for a fixed objective-evaluation budget?
scenario: 5 dimensions, 200 conical peaks, severity 1, period 5000, correlation 0, nexcess 1, 500000 counted objective queries
development_cases: Four new development environment/optimizer seed pairs frozen before observing outcomes, excluding recorded historical identities; all four cases remain throughout selection.
selection: Minimum development mean offline error among complete valid native programs including the target-5 seed; ties by earlier generation, then source SHA256.
fixed_target_selection: Minimum development mean among targets 3 and 5; ties by lower numeric target. Both start at five and change by at most one at each detected event.
fresh_comparison_condition: A distinct selected native descendant strictly improves development mean over both target 5 and target 3; it is not established execution-equivalent to a comparator.
fresh_freeze_order: Freeze exact selected and both reference sources, selection and this analysis before generating four fresh environment/optimizer seed pairs excluding recorded historical identities.
execution_aliases: Use one physical execution for established identical sources/execution rules. Preserve nominal labels and recorded proof; do not infer equivalence merely from similar mean error.
effect_direction: Negative selected-minus-reference offline error favors the selected population rule.
case_weighting: Equal weight for each of four independent paired cases in this one chapter condition.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: Independent environment/optimizer case pair, preserving paired outcomes together.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 95% percentile interval of paired mean; numpy default_rng; no particle/update/environment-level resampling.

influence: Retain every case. Report largest absolute case contribution, fraction of net mean where defined, and every completed-environment contribution; no outlier removal.
behavior: Requested-target distributions at detected changes, realized-neutral-count distributions over subswarm updates, additions/removals, measured total particles and swarm counts over counted queries, query-category shares, spread of simultaneous neutral counts and how target requests differ between swarms. Give cases equal weight; pooled totals are labeled. Summarize target switches and reversals of nonzero resizing direction per persistent swarm identifier; replacement identities begin new lifetimes. Inspect selected source for global workload and history field use. Do not treat distinct swarm count as measured peak coverage.
recovery: Use saved actual query offsets after environmental boundaries. Exclude initialization environment; average environments within case then give cases equal weight. Never interpolate unrecorded immediate error.
population_trajectories: Use counted objective evaluations as time axis. Traces share a registered 100-query grid; average cases at actual common recorded queries and show within-case neutral count spread. No simulation replay.
examples: Prospectively recorded first update, first detected change and first updates reaching quarter, half and three-quarter budgets in each case. Also choose largest negative and largest positive completed-environment contributions, excluding initialization, with ties by case index then environment. These extreme examples are explicitly post hoc, not representative frequencies. Use saved counted-query traces only; retain the unfavorable example and make no replay calls.
development_interpretation: Four development cases informed native selection; descriptive intervals do not correct selection bias and are not a continuation or significance gate. If target 3 beats 5 and no descendant beats 3: A promising fixed-target setting on development data; no additional evolutionary gain demonstrated.
fresh_interpretation: Four fresh independent case pairs provide a small exploratory signal, not confirmation comparable to the chapter fifty-run experiment. A constant winner is population-size tuning. A conditional winner beating targets 3 and 5 does not establish superiority to all constants or isolate adaptation causally. Neither phase reproduces the historical tables or compares SPSO.
no_automatic_extensions: No new regime, shorter horizon, baseline-validation study, repeated search, parameter sweep or fresh stage when trigger fails.
reference_reuse: Ten-peak numerical results cannot be reused. The four new target-5 records are reused for the exact native seed. Execution equivalence requires a recorded source/adapter proof, identical configurations and environment histories, exact budgets, update order and RNG consumption; matching mean errors alone are insufficient.
partial_results: Only complete valid four-case native programs enter selection. --allow-partial emits an explicitly incomplete checkpoint inventory and per-case results without ranking partial means, selecting a winner or setting a fresh trigger. Complete reference-stage analysis remains available before search.
scope: One bounded native batch, at most six descendant slots selected as six/four/two from first full planned reference runtime plus model latency and reserves before mutation. No seed shortening, control sweeps, automatic second campaign, peak-coverage claims or feature-level causal attribution.
